idea-plugin.name: Capybara AI Coding Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
Capybara AI Coding Assistant

An AI-powered coding assistant for IntelliJ IDEA built on OpenCode — free model integration, highly customizable, rapid development experience.

基于 OpenCode 的 IntelliJ IDEA AI 编程助手 —— 自由模型接入、高度自定义、极速开发体验。

Supports any AI model provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, etc.) with streaming chat, code operations, Skill system, MCP protocol integration, and more.

支持自由添加任意 AI 模型提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic、DeepSeek 等），提供流式聊天、代码操作、Skills 技能系统、MCP 协议集成等丰富功能。


Features

  • AI Chat — Streaming chat with multi-turn conversations and real-time SSE updates / 流式聊天界面，支持多轮对话与 SSE 实时更新
  • Session Management — Create, rename, delete, fork, and browse history / 创建、重命名、删除、分叉、历史浏览
  • Multi-Provider — Manage multiple AI providers with custom model support / 自由管理多个 AI 提供商，自定义接入任意兼容模型
  • Skill System — Create, edit, import, export reusable AI prompts with project/global scope / 创建/编辑/导入/导出可复用 AI 指令
  • MCP Server — Local and remote MCP server integration / Model Context Protocol 集成，支持本地与远程服务器
  • Permission Control — Granular allow/ask/deny rules for files, commands, edits, etc. / 按模式粒度为文件/命令/编辑等操作定义规则
  • Code Actions — Right-click menu: explain, optimize, unit test, translate, add to conversation / 右键菜单操作
  • File Search — Search by name or content with fuzzy/exact match and extension filter / 按文件名/内容搜索
  • Diff Viewer — Inline code diff visualization / 代码差异内联可视化
  • Theme — Light and dark themes / 深色/浅色主题
  • Update Check — Auto-detect new versions with one-click download / 自动检测新版本，支持一键跳转下载

Tech Stack

  • Frontend: React 18 + TypeScript 5.2 + Ant Design X
  • Plugin: Kotlin 1.9.20 + IntelliJ Platform 2023.2+
  • AI Backend: OpenCode

Prerequisites

This plugin requires OpenCode to be installed and configured locally.

本插件依赖 OpenCode 服务运行，请确保本地已安装并配置好 OpenCode CLI。


Open Source
